text:
maya: Heads upRepro: on Android 11 emulator (API 30) our okhttp Authenticator sometimes drops the Authorization header on the retried request after a sync token refresh. Only on emulator, ~30% of runs.

devin: Are you returning a new Request from okhttp3.Authenticator.authenticate?

maya: Yup. Simplified:```java
@Override
public Request authenticate(Route r, Response resp) throws IOException {
  String t = tokenProvider.refreshSync();
  return resp.request().newBuilder().header("Authorization","Bearer "+t).build();
}
```
Server logs show some retries arriving without Authorization.

arjun: Does refreshSync() use the same OkHttpClient instance/dispatcher? That can cause subtle timing/deadlock issues.
maya: We use a separate client for refresh. Refresh completes always. Fun fact: disabling connection pooling (ConnectionPool(0,...)) removes the bug.
devin: That points at connection reuse. HTTP/1.1? HTTP/2?
maya: Server is http/1.1. Emulator seems to reuse the same socket.
arjun: Try removeHeader("Authorization").addHeader(...) or building a fresh Request.Builder instead of response.request().newBuilder().
maya: Tried both; frequency lowered but didn't vanish. Doing the refresh async and issuing a fresh call (not via Authenticator return) is stable.
devin: Pragmatic fix for SDK: if we detect emulator API 30, set Connection: close on the retried request or force a new connection. Also add a DX note about emulator quirk.
maya: Filed a tiny repro app against okhttp 4.9.3. Repro on emulator API 30, not on API 31 or devices. Opened upstream issue. Pushed SDK patch that adds .header("Connection","close") for emulator API 30 with a TODO and test.

ci-bot: CI green on branch fix/emulator-auth-30 (unit + small integration). :white_check_mark:

devin: Nice. Please add an e2e job in the cloud emulator matrix for API 30 if infra supports it so we don't regress.
maya: Will do and I'll add entry to devex known-issues doc. Thanks! :thumbsup:
